nodes.description: Mapping(address=>uint256) of account balances; written by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of owner to spender allowances; written by _approve.
Total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Token name assigned once in the ERC20 constructor and read by name().
Token symbol assigned once in the ERC20 constructor and read by symbol().
Generator version string written in the GeneratorCopyright constructor and read by version().
Payable constructor of SimpleERC20: requires initialBalance_ > 0 and mints the whole supply to _msgSender().
Base ERC20 constructor storing name_ and symbol_ into _name and _symbol.
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and credits the recipient balance.
Internal transfer moving amount between two accounts after balance validation.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Public delegated transfer validating and decrementing the caller allowance.
Public approval that sets the spender allowance via _approve for _msgSender().
Increases spender allowance by addedValue using an unchecked addition.
Decreases spender allowance by subtractedValue after a require guard.
Internal allowance writer validating zero-address arguments before writing _allowances.
Internal burn that reduces the account balance and the total supply.
Context helper returning msg.sender to all allowance and transfer paths.
Abstract ServicePayer constructor that forwards msg.value to the receiver through an external call.
Caller-controlled msg.sender obtained through _msgSender(); used as mint recipient and allowance owner.
External call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed during construction of the token.
Balance increment _balances[recipient] += amount (also _balances[account] += amount in _mint).
Subtraction senderBalance - amount inside _transfer.
Subtraction currentAllowance - amount inside transferFrom.
Addition _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue inside increaseAllowance.
Subtraction currentAllowance - subtractedValue inside decreaseAllowance.
Addition _totalSupply += amount inside _mint.
Subtraction _totalSupply -= amount inside _burn.
Token name string parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor.
Token symbol string parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor.
Initial supply parameter minted to the deployer in the SimpleERC20 constructor.
Payable fee receiver parameter passed to ServicePayer for the external pay call.
Local variable caching _balances[sender] inside _transfer.
Local variable caching _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] inside transferFrom.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender, exposing the untrusted caller to every consumer of the helper.
msg.sender via _msgSender becomes the recipient account of the initial _mint.
msg.sender via _msgSender is the sender account used by transfer() when calling _transfer.
msg.sender via _msgSender is the allowance owner written by approve/_approve.
initialBalance_ is passed as the amount minted in _mint.
feeReceiver_ is the receiver targeted by the external pay call.
senderBalance feeds the senderBalance - amount subtraction in _transfer.
currentAllowance feeds the currentAllowance - amount subtraction in transferFrom.
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint after validating the initial supply.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer base constructor for fee payment.
transfer forwards execution to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards execution to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to write back the reduced allowance.
transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount before approving.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance computes _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue.
decreaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
decreaseAllowance computes currentAllowance - subtractedValue.
_transfer increments the recipient balance entry.
_transfer performs senderBalance - amount before crediting.
_mint increments the recipient balance entry.
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount.
_burn performs _totalSupply -= amount.

ServicePayer constructor makes an external call to IPayable(receiver).pay with msg.value while the token is still being constructed, allowing the fee receiver to re-enter construction flow before state is fully initialized.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is only consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor and forwarded to the ERC20 constructor state write.
symbol_ is only consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor and forwarded to the ERC20 constructor state write.
initialBalance_ flows directly into the amount argument of the constructor-triggered _mint call.
feeReceiver_ is used only as the target receiver of the external pay call in ServicePayer.
senderBalance is a temporary cache of _balances[sender] used solely inside _transfer.
currentAllowance is a temporary cache of the caller allowance used solely inside transferFrom.
